# CANDIDATE: CHART_STOP_BUFFER_0DTE_0.30

**Filed:** 2026-07-13  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the chart stop buffer from $0.50 to $0.30 will reduce premature exits on valid bearish rejection setups while maintaining protection against false breaks. The current $0.50 buffer may be too wide in choppy markets, causing unnecessary stops, while a $0.30 buffer better aligns with typical intraday rejection candles observed in J's anchor days.

## Mechanism

Change `params.json#chart_stop_buffer_dollars` from 0.50 to 0.30. The chart stop triggers when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer. Entry logic, TP1 (+50% at 2/3 qty), runner, chandelier profit-lock, and time stop (15:50 ET) remain unchanged. Applies to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (PUT) setup only.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure 1 and playbook risk rules).
2. **Sample bias:** Sweep will test buffer values [$0.10, $0.20, $0.30, $0.40, $0.50, $0.60] over 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 IS. Selection based on max edge_capture. Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on J anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31 OOS pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J anchor days validation pending).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/04 extreme vol may cause larger slippage with tighter buffer; max drawdown scenario: consecutive stopped trades during low-VIX chop; blow-up scenario: buffer too tight causing whipsaws in ranging markets.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X (unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest).
